subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Should maintainers consolidate the Personal-card avatar 401 cluster around https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 after its P1 SDK-surface blocker is fixed, or keep this narrower branch as an alternate repair path?
rationale: This PR is now conflicting and proof-missing, while the broader candidate has positive proof but still has a merge blocker; choosing the canonical landing branch is a maintainer routing decision rather than a safe automatic close.

options.title: Consolidate after the broader PR is repaired
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 as the canonical path once it keeps avatar helpers out of public SDK surface, then close overlapping stale candidates.

options.title: Keep this narrow branch alive
options.body: Ask this contributor to rebase onto current main, fix the type/lint blockers, port the UI change to `ui/src/pages/config/quick.ts`, and attach browser/network proof.

options.title: Wait for another maintainer-owned fix
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and close both external candidates only if maintainers decide to implement the avatar projection path directly.

recommendation.title: Consolidate after the broader PR is repaired
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 as the canonical path once it keeps avatar helpers out of public SDK surface, then close overlapping stale candidates.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history on the current avatar projection lines and the Control UI avatar helper refactors relevant to the branch choice.
